title: Coastal Comfort | KEY.co
description_expanded: The outdoor spaces create a private resort-style setting, complete with a sparkling pool, soothing spa, firepit lounge, and a summer kitchen perfect for open-air dining and evening cookouts. Entertainment continues indoors with a vibrant game room featuring pinball machines, shuffleboard, gaming consoles, and a comfortable media lounge ideal for friendly competition and movie nights. Thoughtfully designed guest suites and inviting bunk spaces ensure everyone has a place to unwind after a day of beach adventures. With included bikes and a six-seat golf cart for exploring nearby dining, cafés, and boutiques, this remarkable coastal haven offers the perfect balance of relaxation, entertainment, and seaside living. Perched in the heart of Seacrest Beach, this expansive Gulf-view retreat offers an elevated coastal experience designed for unforgettable group gatherings. Spanning three spacious levels with convenient elevator access, the home blends sophisticated design with relaxed beachside charm. Sunlit living spaces feature rich wood floors, calming coastal tones, and an impressive chef’s kitchen equipped with professional-grade appliances, generous prep space, and ample seating for shared meals and lively conversation. Just beyond the living areas, balconies capture refreshing Gulf breezes, while the nearby beach access invites effortless days along the shoreline.
